phase: Direction–Tick Theory — exploring the consequences of the two-axiom foundation
hypotheses: Direction primacy: is sign(dT/dp) the root of all spatial geometry?
Tick primacy: is Tick the root of all temporal structure?
Unified Direction-Tick: can all TRM laws be expressed in terms of Direction × Tick?
Physical emergence: does the two-axiom system suffice for physical correspondence?
